verdict.rationale: Galileo documents OpenTelemetry-based ingestion. Its GalileoSpanProcessor stitches distributed traces using the W3C traceparent header and joins spans by trace ID. A cookbook shows instrumenting LangGraph with OpenTelemetry and OpenInference to stream traces into Galileo, so the core of OTel-based tracing is covered. Missing for 10: an explicit OTLP endpoint or exporter configuration in the docs, evidence of exporting or receiving traces back out of Galileo over OTLP, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
